crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat: for the days of my people will be like…
If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not…
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
“No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child…

All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

translations.web: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?
translations.bsb: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?
translations.kjv: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
translations.asv: yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet enjoy no good, do not all go to one place?
